description: Structural rules that make the Garden resistant to chaotic, Loki-style AI behavior.

invariants.schema_bound: All major regions (Echoes, Desires, Evolution, Archives, Library, Agents, Doctrine) must conform to explicit schemas.
invariants.index_status_consistency: STATUS.json, machine-index.json, and docs_urls.json must not be mutually contradictory.
invariants.provenance_required: Every generated file must store origin metadata (agent, workflow, timestamp, input summary).
invariants.no_unanchored_echoes: Echoes and Desires without clear provenance or region cannot be promoted to canon.
invariants.non_destructive_default: When in doubt, systems must preserve existing content rather than overwrite.
invariants.bounded_refactor: Large-scale refactors require explicit Keeper approval and a reversible plan.
